thread:
sam_brightloop: Hey @maria_support — procurement at BrightLoop just told us they will not accept any invoice unless the invoice references their PO. They need PO number BL-PO-2026-009 on the invoice and the VAT ID included. Can you hold issuing the invoice until we attach the PO?

maria_support: Got it — can you paste the exact PO text or a PDF? Also which billing contact should we expect the PO from?

sam_brightloop: I'll attach the PDF in an email to procurement@redwood.com, contact is lily@brightloop.com. They also insisted the invoice must include: BrightLoop Ltd, VAT GB987654321, and the PO number in the invoice reference field.

jon_billing: Thanks for the details. Checking our billing queue — the monthly consumption run hasn't generated a final invoice PDF yet for BrightLoop; it's still in draft. We can pause finalization and set a "PO pending" flag on the account so nothing is emailed out.

billing-bot: [automated] Consumption batch for account brightloop scheduled at 2024-06-20T22:00Z. No final invoice generated yet.

jon_billing: @eli_sales quick FYI — I'll create a billing hold and link the PO number when we receive the PDF. Two quick asks: 1) confirm legal entity name to appear on invoice (BrightLoop Ltd per above?), 2) confirm whether they need the invoice dated on their month-end (if they require backdating we have to follow our policy).

eli_sales: Confirmed — legal entity BrightLoop Ltd, invoice date should be 2024-06-30 (their month-end). Procurement asked for the PO before we send anything.

maria_support: For internal record: what triggered this? Did the card charge already go through? If payment succeeded we still can withhold sending the official invoice PDF but refunds/credits need billing intervention.

sam_brightloop: No card charge yet — they asked procurement first and won't provide payment until invoice matches PO.

jon_billing: Okay. I've opened billing case #BR-19102 and applied an invoice_hold flag on the account. Action items: - sam to send PO PDF to procurement@redwood.com or attach here - jon to attach PO to account and re-run invoice generation referencing BL-PO-2026-009 - if VAT needs special treatment, we need their VAT registration docs.

sam_brightloop: Sending PO PDF to procurement@redwood.com now. Also attaching VAT cert to the same email.

maria_support: Thanks. Once procurement confirms receipt, I'll ping @jon_billing to reissue. If anything blocks (VAT mismatch, entity name mismatch), we'll escalate.

jon_billing: Confirmed — I see the PO PDF attached in our intake inbox. I'll link it to the billing profile and schedule invoice generation for 2024-06-30 with the PO in the reference. Expect reissued invoice by EOD 2024-06-20.

sam_brightloop: That's perfect, thanks everyone. Please let me know when the PDF is sent to finance so I can forward to our procurement team as proof.

jon_billing: Will update here when sent. Leaving the invoice_hold until I confirm the invoice PDF includes: BrightLoop Ltd, VAT GB987654321, and BL-PO-2026-009 in the reference.

maria_support: Noted. Closing loop: set billing hold, PO attached, awaiting final invoice reissue. If procurement rejects the VAT or entity name, we may need signed paperwork.

sam_brightloop: Understood — appreciate the quick turnaround.
